cohort: 182 pregnant women aged 16-45 years, categorized as obese or non-obese, belonging to a lower socioeconomic class, and without pre-existing diabetes, hypertension, renal disease, or bleeding disorders, recruited from an outpatient and inpatient department at Abbasi Shaheed Hospital.
finding: Obese women with gestational diabetes had a statistically significant increased risk of preterm birth.
gest_age: Preterm births occurred at a mean of 34 weeks +/- 3.1 weeks.
